```{r}
police_data <- A24_use_of_force
```

```{r}
police_data |> count(SubjectGender, name="Freq") |>
       arrange(desc(Freq))

```

```{r}
police_data |> 
  mutate(SubjectGender = fct_infreq(SubjectGender)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = SubjectGender)) +
  geom_bar()
```

```{r}
ggplot(police_data, aes(x = SubjectAge))   + geom_bar(aes(fill=SubjectGender))
```

```{r}
police_data |>
  filter(str_detect(IncidentDate, "^11")) |> 
  mutate(Borough = fct_infreq(Borough)) |>
  mutate(Borough = fct_rev(Borough)) |> 
  group_by(Borough) |> 
  filter(n() > 480) |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = Borough)) + geom_bar()

```
